name: event-details-popover
title: Event details popover
description: Click an event on a calendar to read it: title, time in the viewer's zone, place, people and actions, in a panel anchored to the chip.
docs: Pass event and the event chip as children: the chip opens the panel. viewerTimeZone is the reader's own IANA zone; when its clock differs from the event's, both are written, each with the name of its zone. A cancelled event has its title struck through and says Cancelled, a tentative one says so, one that is on says Happening now and one that is over says how long ago (pass now for the same text on the server and in the browser). A long description is cut to four lines with a Show more button that appears only when something is hidden. actions takes your own Buttons for the foot. The popover is non-modal: Escape or a click outside closes it and focus goes back to the chip. The panel is never taller than the room there is: on a short screen it scrolls inside itself and its close button stays in view. EventDetailsPanel is the same content without the popover, for a side panel or a sheet.
